spec.rationale: Types the owner-earnings leg of the operating_business_and_net_assets prose falsifier. The low-case owner_earnings_reinvestment_dcf proof trace locks normalized owner earnings at 692.466 USD millions (FY2025 operating cash flow of 1,282.267M minus capital spending of 589.801M per ALB/investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-K_20260211_rpt20251231_acc0000915913_26_000018.htm and ALB/research/valuation_fact_ledger.json field normalized_owner_earnings_m). If trailing-twelve-month normalized owner earnings at 2026-09-30 resolve below that anchor, distributable owner cash has fallen below the low-case bridge and the bounded per-share range should compress toward the low case (54.89 USD per share vs 100.45 base). Incremental after-tax ROIC and reinvestment-rate legs remain judgment inputs without a resolvable SEC metric and are not typed here. Historical adapter replay on Q3 FY2025 (measurement end 2025-09-30) resolved 121.108 USD millions via sec_companyfacts_ttm using normalized_owner_earnings_ttm_m_v2 (adds PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets to capex concepts). Target Q3 FY2026 is not observable at registration (2026-09-03); expected 10-Q filing ~2026-11-05 per prior-year cadence. Routed-memory leads verified: Q3 FY2025 TTM (121.108M) sits far below the FY2025 point-in-time anchor (692.466M), confirming cycle normalization matters; threshold tracks low-case proof node owner_earnings, not raw OCF.
